description: BDS B2b with the PPP-B2b service on the BDS-3 GEO satellites (PRN 59 to 63) and B-CNAV3 on the others, over the broadcast orbits: the service corrects the B-CNAV1 message of every BDS-3 MEO and IGSO satellite, C19 to C21 by the centimetres between their CNV1 records and the D1 records they fly with, the others by the B-CNAV1 field resolution of their D1 records (under 2 cm); 20 MHz IQ2, 10 s. This scenario starts at 02:00 UTC on 2026-03-20 on the older window brd4_2026079_0200.rnx, the public broadcast files of 2026-08-20 carrying no records of PRN 59 to 63.
name: bds_b2b_ppp_b2b
